visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a tight close-up on a black iron plate where a thick, vibrant orange-red sauce is poured over a grilled whole squid, a rectangular rice block dusted with red chili powder, and a sheet of nori. Steam rises from the hot plate against a slightly blurred kitchen background. (2) A male staff member wearing a white t-shirt, a black face mask, and a camouflage bandana is seen in a medium shot; he is holding a metal grater and a block of white food, grating it vigorously over a bowl of soup curry. (3) A series of quick cuts showcase different menu items: a bowl of Hokkaido-style soup curry with visible eggplant and carrots, a wooden tray with grilled beef slices, and a scoop of white rice topped with toasted, melted cheese. (4) A massive 'Dragon Boat' themed curry platter is presented on a table, featuring rows of sausages, fried shrimp with flags, soft-boiled eggs, and golden French fries. A clear glass is shown being filled with a golden, carbonated beer with a thick white head. (5) A dessert is featured: a scoop of green matcha ice cream sits atop a circular chocolate pudding, drizzled with white cream. The final phase shows a person holding a brown paper bag and a vacuum-sealed 'Wuji Curry' sauce packet in front of the restaurant entrance, followed by a graphic listing store locations in Kaohsiung.
